subject: Vendor sandbox provisioning & PO linkage for AcmeCorp
messages:
From: Oliver Smith <oliver.smith@acme-corp.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@acme-corp.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor registration + PO requirements for sandbox testing

Hi Camila,

We're starting vendor onboarding for Redwood so we can run end-to-end PO and invoice tests in our procurement sandbox next week. Quick asks to get you in our supplier registry: 

- Completed vendor registration spreadsheet (attached): legal name, all DBA names, tax IDs (US EIN / EU VAT), registered address.
- Remit-to banking details (bank name, account number, SWIFT/BIC) OR AP email for EFT.
- Invoice requirements: one PDF per invoice, PO number in the invoice header, line-level PO matching allowed (yes/no).
- Sample test PO: we will create a sandbox PO once you confirm the remit details and invoice format.

We also need to confirm whether Redwood requires self-billing or if you will submit standard invoices referencing a PO. Our sandbox enforces strict 2-way/3-way match rules, so please indicate whether you support sending an invoice with an itemized GL code column.

Can you complete the attached form and reply by EOD Monday? If easier, we can do a 20-min call Monday to walk through the sandbox test flow.

Thanks,
Oliver
Oliver Smith
Procurement Lead, AcmeCorp

Attachment: acme_vendor_registration_form_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Smith <oliver.smith@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + PO requirements for sandbox testing

Hi Oliver — thanks for the note and the form. We're ready to get into your sandbox. Quick answers inline and next steps below.

- Legal name / tax IDs: we'll attach a completed spreadsheet by Monday morning. Our legal name is Redwood Inference, Inc.; US EIN: 12-3456789; EU VAT entity info on the form.
- Remit-to: we prefer to supply bank wiring details for live net terms, but we can also provide an AP inbox for electronic remittals for the sandbox (ap-payments@redwood.com). Please confirm if the sandbox can accept an AP inbox as the remit endpoint for test POs.
- Invoice requirements: we can produce one PDF per invoice with PO number in the header and line-level GL code column. We support both 2-way and 3-way match workflows.
- Self-bill: we do not require self-billing; Redwood will issue standard invoices referencing the PO. If Acme needs a self-bill flow in production, we can discuss separately.

Proposed next steps:
1) We'll fill the attached spreadsheet and send back by Monday 05/31 10:00 PST.
2) Grace (finance ops) will validate the bank remit format with your AP team — looping her in here.
3) Once validated, please provision a sandbox supplier record and issue a test PO (please include a test PO number prefix, e.g., TEST-ACM-xxx).
4) We'll submit a sample invoice PDF and confirm acceptance.

Cc'ing Rishi (sales ops) to ensure any PO-credit hold or contract linkage gets captured for the account record.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_ap_onboarding_packet.pdf (PDF)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Smith <oliver.smith@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, AP Team <ap@acme-corp.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + PO requirements for sandbox testing

Hi Oliver — Grace from Redwood Finance Ops here. Two quick clarifications to avoid churn during testing: 

1) Bank remit format: please confirm field mapping your sandbox expects. Our preferred wire fields are: beneficiary name, beneficiary address, bank name, IBAN/Account, SWIFT/BIC, payment reference (max 35 chars). If your sandbox restricts the reference length, let us know so we can populate the invoice reference accordingly.

2) PO matching rules: will the sandbox enforce line-item quantity/price match OR GL-code-only match? For the test we can send both a perfectly matching invoice and a deliberately mismatched invoice to validate exception handling. 

3) Tax handling: for EU testing, will your sandbox accept VAT as a separate tax line or is VAT included in unit price? We will include VAT breakdowns in our sample invoice.

If helpful, we can share two sample invoice PDFs (one with GL codes, one without) and a short mapping doc. I can be on the call Monday if you want to run through the end-to-end flow.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Finance Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Oliver Smith <oliver.smith@acme-corp.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@acme-corp.com>, Jamie Lopez <jamie.lopez@procure-acme.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + PO requirements for sandbox testing

Thanks Camila/Grace — this is helpful. A couple of notes from the sandbox side: 

- Sandbox remit: we can accept an AP email for testing (ap-sandbox@acme-corp.com) but the test PO will only fully pass if a bank-wiring payload is present in the invoice metadata. In other words, your sandbox submission path should include bank fields even if the funds aren't moved.
- Line matching: the sandbox supports three match profiles. For your test we'll run Profile B (line-level quantity and price match + GL code optional).
- VAT: the sandbox expects VAT as an explicit tax line. Please include VAT rate and VAT amount as separate fields in the invoice XML/metadata.
- Test PO: TEST-ACM-20270530-001 (will appear in the sandbox tomorrow 05/31 02:00 PST). Please reference the exact PO number in the invoice header for matching.

I've attached a short sandbox spec and a sample payload (JSON) for uploading an invoice metadata file. If you can drop the completed excel and an invoice PDF into the Drive link I shared, we'll pick it up and run the acceptance test.

Oliver

Attachment: acme_sandbox_specs_v1.pdf (PDF)

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Smith <oliver.smith@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + PO requirements for sandbox testing

Perfect — thanks for provisioning the test PO, Oliver. We completed the registration spreadsheet and uploaded the files to the Drive link you sent (folder: AcmeSandbox/RedwoodFiles). Uploaded items: completed vendor form (acme_vendor_registration_form_v2_completed.xlsx), sample-invoice-TEST-ACM-20270530-001.pdf, and invoice-metadata-TEST-ACM-20270530-001.json.

Summary of what we sent: 
- Vendor form: legal name, US EIN, Redwood EU VAT entity, principal address, authorized signatory.
- Bank remit: wire fields included (IBAN/Account, SWIFT) in metadata for the sandbox. For production we will supply enhanced remittance banking instructions via secure portal.
- Sample invoice: single PDF, PO header with TEST-ACM-20270530-001, line-level itemization and tax line (VAT 20%), GL code column present.

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm receipt and whether the sandbox accepted metadata/attachment pair.
2) If the test fails, please send the sandbox rejection reason (field + expected format).
3) After sandbox acceptance we will schedule a 30-min post-test sync with Grace to confirm production mapping and cutover checklist.

Thanks everyone — cc'ing Rishi to convert the sandbox test outcome into the account onboarding checklist for the deal.

Best,
Camila
Camila Reyes
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
